title: Tools
status: all twenty private sample candidates prepared; not installed

tools.name: Exact AtomSpace recall
tools.adds: Recall candidate references by explicit symbolic keys; reconcile with semantic search later.
tools.claim_ceiling: Native sample tested separately; neither whole-memory retrieval nor truth/authority.
tools.sample_scope: Exact-key candidate recall; no semantic retrieval or whole-history context builder.

tools.name: Attention Bank and Focus
tools.adds: Allocate finite attention; decay salience; select relevant context and account for useful recall.
tools.claim_ceiling: Historical component evidence; continuing resident attention economy remains unproven.
tools.sample_scope: Native rank/tie-break and wage/rent state proposals; no continuing attention daemon.

tools.name: Goal Weaver
tools.adds: Represent goal lifecycle, bound progress evidence, refuse stale transitions and identify the next direction.
tools.claim_ceiling: Native sample advisory only; no scheduler or authenticated completion.
tools.sample_scope: Native lifecycle transition appraisal; existing Hive Goals retain orchestration.

tools.name: LivingIntent and commitment continuity
tools.adds: Preserve why a goal matters, its current direction and commitments across episodes.
tools.claim_ceiling: Historical component evidence; enduring multi-goal agency remains unproven.
tools.sample_scope: Current projection binding and stale-return refusal; no autonomous goal creation.

tools.name: Standing values and retention covenants
tools.adds: Separate nominated importance from adopted commitments; protect explicitly retained memories.
tools.claim_ceiling: Adoption must bind a real owner decision; identifiers and hashes alone do not authenticate.
tools.sample_scope: Value-transition appraisal and content/access/retention checks; no authenticated adoption or deletion.

tools.name: Flourishing and protected floors
tools.adds: Compare impacts across constituencies and dimensions without collapsing unknowns into one moral score.
tools.claim_ceiling: Fixture impacts and constituency coverage are incomplete; protected floors need accountable adoption.
tools.sample_scope: Finite constituency dominance/incomparability and floor-conflict reporting; no universal ethics engine.

tools.name: Epistemic immune system
tools.adds: Track provenance, dispute, quarantine and revision independently from confidence.
tools.claim_ceiling: Experimental component contracts; governed memory is not necessarily truthful memory.
tools.sample_scope: Coherence/support classification and overlap-aware revision; no proof of truth or canonical admission.

tools.name: Revisable self-observation
tools.adds: Bind a self-model to actual observations and invoked capabilities rather than fluent self-description.
tools.claim_ceiling: Current evidence and stale/duplicate refusal needed; not consciousness evidence.
tools.sample_scope: Current-turn/focus receipt readback; no consciousness or identity claim.

tools.name: Formal reasoning ensemble
tools.adds: Preserve competing derivations, provenance overlap and disagreement without inventing a winner.
tools.claim_ceiling: NAL/PLN donor interfaces and bounded components; calibration/integration outstanding.
tools.sample_scope: Typed claim-coordinate relationship classification; no reasoner activation or TV fusion.

tools.name: Predictive coding and concept formation
tools.adds: Record predictions before outcomes; update concepts from residuals with provenance.
tools.claim_ceiling: Prototype contracts; not a demonstrated lifelong learner.
tools.sample_scope: Prediction-before-target binary Brier scoring; no trained world model or concept learner.

tools.name: Scratch AtomSpaces and planning
tools.adds: Explore hypotheses and task graphs in isolated spaces; explicitly promote accepted results.
tools.claim_ceiling: Scratch separation is not effect isolation; plugin must not start a second coordinator.
tools.sample_scope: Scope/version/expiry-bound promotion proposal; no persistent scratch manager or full planner.

tools.name: Curiosity and autonomous research
tools.adds: Nominate useful unknowns, spend bounded novelty effort and retire expired explorations.
tools.claim_ceiling: Research nomination cannot grant network, spending or publication authority.
tools.sample_scope: Source/quota/expiry-bound inspect-only opportunity proposal; no research executor or external permission.

tools.name: Sleep and dream consolidation
tools.adds: Consolidate derived views without rewriting original evidence; distinguish dreams from observations.
tools.claim_ceiling: Sleep-related paths have narrow evidence; dream organ remains an experimental proposal.
tools.sample_scope: Protected-reference-aware deduplication candidate for wake review; no dream generation or destructive consolidation.

tools.name: Cognitive economics and resource reserves
tools.adds: Track cognitive effort, provider costs and reserve separately; reconcile terminal uncertainty.
tools.claim_ceiling: Typed accounting components; money/energy labels do not enforce external budgets by themselves.
tools.sample_scope: Native cognitive-energy reservation/settlement proposals; no spending or provider permission.

tools.name: Affect, rest and proactivity
tools.adds: Represent fatigue, initiative and silence as inspectable agent state rather than engagement targets.
tools.claim_ceiling: Controller remains unassembled; affect cannot authorize an external action.
tools.sample_scope: Debt/energy/availability-based rest/quiet-work suggestion; no complete affect or motivation controller.

tools.name: Capability discovery and affordance
tools.adds: Expose versioned skills, prerequisites, nomination, admission and execution evidence.
tools.claim_ceiling: Discovery is not permission; installation must remain distinct from grants.
tools.sample_scope: Versioned descriptor/prerequisite nomination; no installer or automatic execution grant.

tools.name: AtomSpace substrate adapters
tools.adds: Expose compatible native spaces and inspect substrate capabilities rather than assuming parity.
tools.claim_ceiling: PeTTa current target; MORK/Jetta remain separate port/research work.
tools.sample_scope: Declared feature-fit inspection; no backend migration, MORK/Jetta implementation or automatic runtime discovery.

tools.name: Habitat snapshot inspection
tools.adds: Query supplied room observations while preserving snapshot revision and provenance.
tools.claim_ceiling: Synthetic native example; no sensor connection or physical control.
tools.sample_scope: Room inspection over supplied synthetic snapshots; no real sensing.

tools.name: Home Assistant body module
tools.adds: Sense devices, inspect house affordances, act through a physical adapter, and record outcomes.
tools.claim_ceiling: Existing optional module, disabled by default; port and exact effect policy review required.
tools.sample_scope: Fresh target/revision-bound on/off service proposal plus dormant donor mapper; no live device action.

tools.name: Aware Habitat to Living Home
tools.adds: Develop physical awareness, consented household understanding, then delegated home management including networks, security, bills and shopping.
tools.claim_ceiling: Staged theory/product scope; relationships never authenticate users or grant authority.
tools.sample_scope: Staged readiness guidance preserving awareness/relationships/control destination; no household surveillance or management daemon.
